preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 3 and 3000, inclusive.
Each station number xi and yi is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No station is directly connected to itself.

preconditions.expression: No pair of stations share more than one passage.
preconditions.description: There is at most one passage between any pair of stations.

preconditions.expression: The given description represents a classic subway scheme.
preconditions.description: The scheme is fully connected, meaning one can travel from any station to any other one along the passages.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers, each representing the distance from the i-th station to the ringroad.

postconditions.expression: The distance to the ringroad is 0 for ringroad stations.
postconditions.description: For stations that are part of the ringroad, the distance is 0.

postconditions.expression: The output is correct for all valid inputs.
postconditions.description: The output is guaranteed to correctly represent the distances from the ringroad for all stations in the given subway scheme.

invariants.expression: The scheme is a single cycle.
invariants.description: The stations form a single cycle, meaning each station is connected to exactly two other stations, forming a loop.
